org.geysermc.paletter.block.component.MaterialInstances
Record Components:
all - Add-on JSON *. Optional (null: not set).
allAlias - The string form of {@code *} (alias); excludes {@link #all()}. Add-on JSON *.
down - Add-on JSON down. Optional (null: not set).
downAlias - The string form of {@code down} (alias); excludes {@link #down()}. Add-on JSON down.
east - Add-on JSON east. Optional (null: not set).
eastAlias - The string form of {@code east} (alias); excludes {@link #east()}. Add-on JSON east.
north - Add-on JSON north. Optional (null: not set).

upAlias - The string form of {@code up} (alias); excludes {@link #up()}. Add-on JSON up.
west - Add-on JSON west. Optional (null: not set).
westAlias - The string form of {@code west} (alias); excludes {@link #west()}. Add-on JSON west.
instances - Instances with any other name, which geometry bones refer to (for example {@code "glass"}); the keys {@code *}, {@code up}, {@code down}, {@code north}, {@code south}, {@code east} and {@code west} have their own fields. Add-on JSON *. Default: {}.

@BedrockFormat("1.19.40") public record MaterialInstances(@Nullable MaterialInstances.Instance all, @Nullable String allAlias, @Nullable MaterialInstances.Instance down, @Nullable String downAlias, @Nullable MaterialInstances.Instance east, @Nullable String eastAlias, @Nullable MaterialInstances.Instance north, @Nullable String northAlias, @Nullable MaterialInstances.Instance south, @Nullable String southAlias, @Nullable MaterialInstances.Instance up, @Nullable String upAlias, @Nullable MaterialInstances.Instance west, @Nullable String westAlias, @NonNull Map<String,MaterialInstances.Instance> instances, @NonNull Map<String,String> aliases) extends Record implements BlockComponent
The material instances for a block. Maps face or material_instance names in a geometry file to an actual material instance. Material instance can either be a full material instance or a name to another already defined instance. Limited to 64 instances.

Add-on JSON: "minecraft:material_instances". Compiled by the hand transform material_instances (see data/model/transforms.json).

Since:
1.0.0
